title: Trinity Transport Envelope
description: Authoritative shape for any signed transport-delivered request. Cf. docs/specs/TRINITY_TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY_SPEC_V1.md §3.1. Article XV anchor: 'Transport is not Authority' — this envelope is the boundary; HMAC verification happens kernel-side via .ai/cli/core/transport.verify_envelope().

envelope_id.description: Unique opaque identifier (UUID4 hex or ULID); used for replay detection per spec §3.1 + §5.5.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC wall-clock timestamp of envelope creation at the transport.

source_transport.description: Identity of the transport that produced this envelope (e.g. 'tg-bot', 'notify-cli', 'slack-bridge').

claimed_actor.description: Actor on whose behalf this envelope is sent — '<authority_class>:<transport_hint>:<actor_id>' per spec §3.2. Forbidden classes (kernel, policy, verifier) trigger TRANSPORT_REFUSED_OVERSCOPE downstream — schema permits the syntax but kernel rejects at §4.5 step 4.

payload.description: Request body — must be a JSON object; canonicalised before signing per spec §3.3.

kind.description: Payload kind (e.g. 'ddd.decision', 'verifier.observation'); used by downstream Authority organs for routing.

hmac.description: Lowercase hex HMAC over canonical JSON of envelope minus this field. Required for mutating envelopes (any state-changing payload); optional only for pure read-only observation envelopes. v1 pins HMAC-SHA256 (spec §4.1).

hmac_alg.description: Algorithm identifier — v1 pins HMAC-SHA256 (spec §4.1). Any other value MUST be refused with TRANSPORT_REFUSED_BADKEY.

key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key used; the Kernel resolves this to the issuing Authority organ via its key registry (spec §4.2).

nonce.description: Optional per-envelope nonce for replay protection; if absent, envelope_id doubles as nonce (spec §3.1).

expires_ts.description: Optional envelope expiry; Kernel rejects envelopes received after this timestamp with TRANSPORT_REFUSED_REPLAY (spec §5.5 conflation).
